name: hkx-refactor-flow
description: Behavior-preserving refactor: map the refactor surface, clean with in-step planning from the exploration evidence, then dual review.

chain.label: Map refactor surface
chain.task:
Map the refactor surface for:

{task}

Identify duplication, dead paths, boundary smells, tests that protect behavior, and safe cleanup units.
Do not modify project/source files; write findings to the configured output artifact.

chain.label: Plan and apply cleanup
chain.task:
Execute the behavior-preserving refactor for:

{task}

Codebase context from exploration:
{outputs.context}

First, draft a short refactor plan directly from the exploration evidence (small reversible cleanup units in order, validation after each unit, no feature changes) and include it at the top of your report. Then execute that plan in the same run.

Rules:
- Sole writer for the active worktree.
- Preserve behavior; delete only with evidence.
- Keep diffs focused; validate after changes.

Return the in-step plan, changed files, deletions, validation, and anything intentionally deferred.

parallel.label: Behavior review
parallel.task:
Review the refactor for behavior preservation and accidental scope creep.

Request:
{task}

Implementation:
{outputs.impl}

Inspect the actual diff. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings via the configured output artifact is allowed.

Configured output path is under `.pi-subagents/` (gitignored) and is the only permitted write target for this review. Do not modify project/source files. Do not request supervisor input solely to write that configured review artifact. If a tool or permission layer blocks the write, retry once; parent auto-reply may handle artifact-only authorization.

parallel.label: Safety-net review
